description: This PHP class TemplateHelper facilitates rendering of email templates using the Twig templating engine. It initializes a Twig environment with an array loader and provides methods to access the environment and render templates with provided context, handling exceptions during rendering.

classes.name: TemplateHelper
classes.description: Helper class for rendering email templates using Twig with methods to initialize the Twig environment and render templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes Twig environment with an empty ArrayLoader.

methods.name: renderTemplate
methods.description: Renders a Twig template string with the provided context array. Throws TemplateRenderException if rendering fails.
